commands.name: tdd
commands.description: Show the TDD guard status and recent events; /tdd why explains the words on the band; /tdd setup detects where your tests live; /tdd receipt prints the receipt for a pull request; /tdd approve and /tdd deny <why> decide an override request; /tdd pause <minutes> <reason> and /tdd resume; /tdd override end <module|pause>

tools.name: override_request
tools.description: Ask to pass the TDD guard, with a reason. Use it only when writing or pinning a test first does not fit. The approver this repo set decides: the person, or a reviewer model the repo opted into. The request and the decision are recorded in dope-tdd.overrides.json and shown on the receipt. If it waits for the person, stop and wait. scope: change (one edit), module (every edit to the module, until what "until" names), pause (every module, for "minutes").

tools.name: status
tools.description: Report the TDD guard state: paused or on, phase, current module, counts, and the recent event log.
